When I tried to fetch the pages (Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Ellicott, Gill and the Pulpit Commentary on Bible Hub and StudyLight), the system said I had no tool calls left for this turn. No page content came back. You asked me to report only what the pages actually say, so I haven't filled the gaps from my own knowledge, and I have nothing verse by verse to give you yet.

If you ask again in a new message, I'll start over and work through:

1. **Traditional reading:** Enduring Word, Precept Austin, and Ellicott, Gill, Pulpit Commentary and Wesley's notes on Bible Hub and StudyLight.
2. **Where Protestant traditions differ:** sites like Desiring God, GTY, Ligonier, Seedbed and 1517, mainly where verses 15–19 touch marriage and sexuality, and verses 21–23 touch sin and judgment.
3. **Other views:** NET Bible notes on the Hebrew (e.g., the "forbidden woman," wormwood, Sheol, the cistern and well imagery in verses 15–17), Bible Odyssey, and any Catholic or Orthodox reading I can find on New Advent, Catholic.com or OCA.org.

Every point will have its URL, and I'll leave out anything I can't find.
